freeze.note: Prompts frozen after the dev phase. Arm D base picked by the rule in plan.json: A earned 5/6, B earned 6/6 on dev scenarios.
freeze.deviationFromPlan: plan.json said dev runs made with the frozen prompt hash would be kept. After the dev phase the engine changed (longer backoff on Vertex 429s, the baseline's own final report at the deadline instead of the reporting agent, deadline stop reasons, critic decisions taking precedence over budget stops), so the dev runs no longer reflect the frozen system. They are archived in eval/runs-dev/ and used only for what the plan assigned them (cost per run and arm D's base); every scored run is made after the freeze, dev scenarios included.

plan.budgetCounts: every recorded run in eval/runs/, including the dev phase; estimated at standard list rates
plan.headlineComparison: Arm A (split by source, then critique) is the multi-agent implementation compared with the single-agent baseline (arm E). Arms B, C and D are variants/ablations.

phases.description: Dev scenarios (s01, s02, s04, s06, s12, s13, variant A) on arms A, B and E. Measures cost per run, allows prompt iteration, and picks arm D's base.

Freeze prompts (hash in eval/results/freeze.json) before the first held-out run. If prompts change after the freeze, every run is redone and the change is reported. Dev runs made with the frozen prompt hash are kept.
Arms A and E on every remaining world (held-out A variants and all B variants), paired per world.
Arms B and C on every A variant; arm D on every A variant if Jev is available.
Arms B, C and D on the B variants.

plan.stopRule: Stop starting new runs when the estimated spend would exceed the budget; report the coverage reached.
plan.armDBaseRule: Arm D's base is whichever of A and B earns more on the dev scenarios (root-cause credit plus correct abstentions). Tie: the one with the lower mean estimated cost per run.
notes: Crashed runs are recorded as failed and never silently rerun.
Arm D and the judge need OPENROUTER_API_KEY; if it is unavailable they are reported as not run.
